_note: Draft inspection of the cube at the arrivals counter.

a.speaker: port_officer
a.text: Your cube says “human detective.” Twice. I’d call that a match.

c.speaker: port_officer
c.text: The missing-user report is clipped to your entry papers. Read it when you have a minute.

cleared.speaker: port_officer
cleared.text: That’s your transfer stamp. You’re cleared, detective.
